verdict.rationale: The hosted reference at api.capacities.io/docs renders the OpenAPI 3.0 spec as an interactive dashboard where you paste a Bearer token and make live requests. The successor portal at developers.capacities.io advertises an interactive OpenAPI spec with every endpoint, schema, rate limit, and TypeScript SDK sample. The probe's 404s were on docs.capacities.io paths, not the documented api.capacities.io/openapi.json, so they don't contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the try-it console and runnable samples work, clarity on the Beta reference being discontinued September 1, 2026 versus the new portal, and runnable code samples evidenced only for the successor portal.
